backends.description: List of backend Cyrus servers to which Murder proxies mailboxes. Each entry defines a backend.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend Cyrus server.

port.description: IMAP port (typically 2000) on the backend server.

weight.description: Relative weight for load balancing — higher values receive more connections.

check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between backend health checks. Set to 0 to disable.

hostname.description: The hostname this Murder proxy instance reports — used in logging and client identification.

ldap.description: LDAP-based dynamic backend discovery (optional). If enabled, overrides static backend list.

base.description: Base DN for backend server lookups.

bind_dn.description: DN to bind as for LDAP queries.

bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind (store securely in production).

filter.description: LDAP search filter to identify backend servers.

max_backend_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed to each backend server.

tls.description: TLS configuration for secure backend connections.

cacert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying backend certificates.

cert.description: Path to client certificate (for mutual TLS if required).

enabled.description: Enable TLS for connections to backend servers.

murder_enabled.description: Enable the Cyrus Murder proxy/aggregator role. When false, Murder functionality is disabled.
